t: can you use a Walgreen's gift card to buy a Disney gift card?? | DIS Disney Discussion Forums - DISboards.com
s: May 7, 2012 - Just got my 6th Disney GC at Walgreens using a Walgreens GC that I got from MyPoints. I have gotten them at various stores. If you ask, they will say "YOU CAN'T BUY A GC WITH A GC!" Yesterday, for example, I got a Disney GC, and 4-5 other items (maybe $10-20 of other merch.), swiped my $50 Walgreens GC (I sometimes just say I am using 2 different cards) it takes off $50, then I swipe my CC for the balance, The only time that I have had trouble is when I cut the amounts too close using coupons etc.
